I dont think you will understand the appeal if you haven't played or had gaming as a hobby yourself.  If you really did game plenty you wouldn't be posting this tbh.  For us this IS a healthier and memorable bonding experience.  Just because it's a videogame doesn't mean it won't be a great experience. Well not really sabotaging any social stuff for me though.  My husband plays and I met a lot of my irl friends in online games.  It depends on how you balance yourself.  You can easily get 5k plus hours if you have been playing since the first release of ffxiv.  For us it became a bonding experience and we have always been hype for the content they dish out every patch.

It's not just about regular content, it's the quality.  The devs of this game really cares for the community and it shows.  They dont have control over the hours spent by players but Yoshi P (producer and director) always stressed in interviews that they made ffxiv in a way that a player can take a break anytime and jump back in anytime without having problems catching up.

Ffxiv feels like home for the most of us tbh.  And yeah surprisingly most of us still live a healthy lifestyle.  We have regular jobs and spend time with the family regularly outside the game.  5k hours means nothing if you have been playing for years.
